# ledger_category (Data Source)

Reads one Ledger category by identifier or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (ignoring case); parent_id = "none" restricts the search to top-level categories.
data "ledger_category" "housing" {
  name      = "housing"
  parent_id = "none"
}

# Or by identifier.
data "ledger_category" "by_id" {
  id = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier. Set `id` or `name`, not both.
- `name` (String) The name, matched ignoring case (Ledger names are unique ignoring case); it is returned as written. Archived ones are found too. Set `id` or `name`, not both.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent category's identifier, or null for a top-level category. When looking up by `name`, set it to narrow the search to the children of that parent, or to `none` for top-level categories; a name shared by a top-level category and a child is otherwise ambiguous.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether it is archived.
- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.
